intro.title: Discover Valley of the Mills Park
intro.description: Valley of the Mills Park (Parcul „Valea Morilor”) is one of the most beautiful and visited parks in Chișinău, located on the banks of the Bâc River. The park offers a peaceful and scenic environment, making it an ideal place for walks, relaxation, and outdoor activities. With its scenic lake, shady alleys, and extensive green spaces, it is a favorite destination for both locals and tourists.

visitGuide.title: Visit Tips
items: The park is accessible year-round and admission is free.
Great place for a picnic or a relaxing walk along the shady alleys.
Provides excellent views of the lake and the central monument.

knowledge.title: About Valley of the Mills Park

sections.title: Historical Background
sections.content: Valley of the Mills Park was created in the 1950s and represents one of the most important tourist and recreational attractions in Chișinău. Its name comes from the windmills that existed in this area in the last century. Over time, the park has undergone several renovations, becoming a modern relaxation space.

sections.title: Geography & Layout
sections.content: The park is organized around a scenic lake, which is the central point of attraction. The shady alleys and green spaces offer multiple opportunities for walking and relaxation. In the center stands an emblematic monument, which often hosts cultural and artistic events.

sections.title: Cultural Significance
sections.content: As the 'green lung' of Chișinău, the park is not only a place for relaxation but also a hub for public events. During summer, open-air concerts, festivals, and other cultural activities are often organized here, being a favorite meeting place for city residents.

sections.title: Ecology & Flora
sections.content: The park hosts a rich variety of plant species, offering distinct landscapes throughout the seasons. From cherry blossoms in spring to vibrant foliage in autumn, it is a haven for nature lovers and an important habitat for urban birds and small wildlife.

officialManagement.title: About Valley of the Mills Park
officialManagement.text: Valley of the Mills Park is located in the heart of Chișinău, Moldova, and is one of the city's most representative green spaces. It perfectly integrates natural landscapes with recreational areas, providing a peaceful oasis for both residents and tourists. The ecological protection and tourism management of this area are jointly coordinated by the Chișinău City Hall (Primăria municipiului Chișinău) and the national tourism authorities of Moldova.
